features.name: Cloudflare infrastructure migration
features.description: Migrate hosting from Vercel to Cloudflare Workers via @opennextjs/cloudflare; add wrangler.jsonc, open-next.config.ts; upgrade Next.js 14→16 and React 18→19 (required by @opennextjs/cloudflare's peer range)
features.evidence: wrangler.jsonc/open-next.config.ts present; npm run build passes locally after fixing async params/searchParams/cookies() and useFormState→useActionState for Next 16; deployed successfully to Cloudflare Workers (https://foodie.beemonswtf.web.id returns 200) after also fixing a Worker-bundle-size overage caused by next/og in app/icon.js (replaced with a static app/icon.svg)

features.name: D1 + R2 data layer rewrite
features.description: Replace @vercel/postgres and @aws-sdk/client-s3 with Cloudflare D1 (SQLite dialect queries) and R2 (image storage); add custom error classes
features.evidence: lib/db.js, lib/storage.js, lib/errors.js added; lib/meals.js and lib/actions.js rewritten for D1's ? placeholders and R2's bucket.put(); no @vercel/postgres or @aws-sdk/client-s3 references remain in the codebase (verified via grep)

features.name: Ratings feature
features.description: Star ratings on meal cards and detail page; one vote per browser per meal via cookie
features.evidence: components/meals/star-rating.js (display) + rating-widget.js (interactive, useTransition + react-hot-toast); lib/actions.js rateMeal() checks/sets a `rated_<slug>` cookie; lib/meals.js rateMeal() does the atomic rating_sum/rating_count UPDATE

features.name: Pagination
features.description: Replace the fixed 50-item /meals limit with real page-based pagination
features.evidence: components/pagination/pagination.js; app/meals/page.js uses PAGE_SIZE=12 with limit/offset and a Pagination component that preserves active filters

features.name: Favorites (client-side bookmarks)
features.description: localStorage-based favorites with no account system; /favorites page and /api/meals?slugs= endpoint to resolve them
features.evidence: lib/hooks/use-favorites.js, components/meals/favorite-button.js + favorites-view.js, app/favorites/page.js (noindex via metadata.robots), app/api/meals/route.js

features.name: Search UX improvements
features.description: Debounce free-text search, auto-apply category/difficulty filters, reset pagination on filter change
features.evidence: components/meals-filter/meals-filter.js: 400ms debounce on search input, immediate apply on select change, deletes the `page` param on any filter change

features.name: UI redesign: warm editorial design system
features.description: Replace the dark gradient/wavy-SVG template look with a cream/charcoal/terracotta palette, self-hosted Fraunces + Inter fonts, and a redesigned header, home, meals grid/detail, share form, and community page
features.evidence: app/globals.css design tokens; next/font/google in app/layout.js; every component .module.css rewritten; components/main-header/main-header-background.* (decorative SVG) deleted; app/icon.png (busy illustration) replaced with app/icon.svg

features.name: SEO
features.description: Dynamic sitemap covering every recipe, canonical URLs, Recipe + BreadcrumbList JSON-LD, robots.txt rules, noindex on filtered/personalized views
features.evidence: app/sitemap.js (force-dynamic, queries lib/meals.getAllMealSlugs); alternates.canonical on every page's metadata; breadcrumbLd + jsonLd scripts in app/meals/[mealSlug]/page.js; public/robots.txt disallows /api/ and /favorites; app/meals/page.js sets robots noindex when filters are active; app/favorites/page.js sets robots noindex always

features.name: Production data seeding
features.description: Apply D1 migrations/seed and upload demo images to the real (remote) D1 database and R2 bucket so the deployed site actually shows content
features.evidence: User confirmed images now render on the live site (https://foodie.beemonswtf.web.id) after running `node scripts/upload-seed-images.mjs --remote` and redeploying with the corrected NEXT_PUBLIC_R2_PUBLIC_URL (foodie-cdn.beemonswtf.web.id).
